name: Low-top sneaker
definition: lace-up athletic-style shoe cut below the ankle bone.

name: High-top sneaker
definition: lace-up athletic-style shoe whose upper rises over the ankle bone.

name: Slip-on sneaker
definition: laceless athletic-style shoe with elastic panels or a stretch collar.

name: Running shoe
definition: cushioned road-running shoe.

name: Trail running shoe
definition: running shoe with a lugged outsole for off-road ground.

name: Walking shoe
definition: cushioned shoe made for walking.

name: Skate shoe
definition: shoe with a durable upper and flat grip sole made for skateboarding.

name: Chunky (dad) sneaker
definition: sneaker with an oversized, sculpted midsole as the main design feature.

name: Minimalist (barefoot) shoe
definition: very thin, flexible, low or zero-drop sole shaped to the foot, including five-toe designs.

name: Hiking shoe (low)
definition: low-cut lace-up shoe made for walking on rough ground, with a flexible lugged sole.

name: Water shoe (aqua shoe)
definition: drainable shoe made for use in and beside water.

name: Oxford
definition: fastened shoe with the lace eyelets stitched under the vamp (closed lacing).

name: Derby
definition: fastened shoe with the lace eyelets stitched on top of the vamp (open lacing).

name: Monk strap
definition: fastened shoe closed by a buckled strap across the instep instead of laces.

name: Saddle shoe
definition: lace-up shoe with a contrasting saddle-shaped band across the instep.

name: Loafer
definition: laceless low shoe with a moccasin-style construction and a closed heel.

name: Boat (deck) shoe
definition: low shoe with a siped non-marking sole, usually with a leather lace running round the upper.

name: Moccasin
definition: shoe made of a soft sole-and-upper wrap with a plug or apron at the toe.

name: Espadrille
definition: canvas or fabric shoe on a rope (jute) sole or wedge.

name: Mule
definition: any backless shoe with a closed toe; a backless shoe with a loafer upper is a mule.

name: Clog
definition: slip-on with a thick rigid sole of wood or moulded material, backed or backless.

name: Plain slip-on shoe
definition: laceless low shoe with a closed heel over a covered instep, on a moulded or stitched outsole, built as none of the kinds above (not moccasin-built, no siped deck sole, no rope sole, no thick rigid clog sole); includes elastic-gored, quilted and sheepskin-lined slip-ons on a moulded outsole.

name: Court shoe (pump)
definition: low-cut closed-heel shoe with a high or low heel and no fastening.

name: Slingback
definition: court-cut shoe held by a strap round the back of the heel.

name: Mary Jane
definition: low-cut shoe with a strap across the instep.

name: Ballet flat
definition: flat or near-flat low-cut shoe with a thin sole and a rounded, shallow vamp.

name: Peep-toe shoe
definition: court-cut shoe with an opening at the toe.

name: Ankle boot (bootie)
definition: short boot ending at or just above the ankle, any closure.

name: Chelsea boot
definition: ankle boot with elastic side gussets and no laces.

name: Chukka (desert boot)
definition: ankle boot with two or three eyelet pairs and an unlined or soft construction.

name: Service and dress lace-up boot
definition: lace-up boot on a plain, sleeker last, without a heavy lugged or wedge work sole.

name: Work boot
definition: lace-up boot with a heavy lugged or wedge outsole made for labour, usually Goodyear-welted or stitch-down.

name: Engineer boot
definition: pull-on boot with a strap and buckle at the instep and the top, no laces.

name: Combat (military) boot
definition: lace-up boot made to a military service pattern.

name: Hiking boot
definition: lace-up boot made for walking on rough ground: padded collar, flexible lugged sole; not made for labour.

name: Motorcycle boot
definition: boot with reinforced ankle and shin and a gear-shift area, made for riding a motorcycle.

name: Sheepskin-lined pull-on boot
definition: pull-on boot of sheepskin with a fleece lining and a soft, moulded sole.

name: Split-toe work boot (jika-tabi)
definition: boot with a separated big toe and a rubber sole, fastened by hooks or a zip up the lower leg.

name: Cowboy (western) boot
definition: pull-on boot with a stitched shaft, pointed or rounded toe and angled heel in the western pattern.

name: Rain boot (wellington)
definition: waterproof rubber or synthetic boot made for wet ground.

name: Snow and winter boot
definition: insulated, waterproof boot with a lugged sole made for cold and snow.

name: Knee-high boot
definition: boot with the shaft reaching to the knee.

name: Over-the-knee (thigh) boot
definition: boot with the shaft above the knee.

name: Equestrian riding boot
definition: tall field or dress boot made for riding (smooth sole, spur rest, close fit).

name: Riding-style boot
definition: tall boot in the equestrian pattern made for everyday wear.

name: Flip-flop (thonged flat sandal)
definition: flat sandal held only by a toe post between the first two toes and the strap that runs from it to the sides of the sole, with no other strap across or round the foot.

name: Slide
definition: backless sandal with a band or straps over the front of the foot.

name: Flat strap sandal
definition: flat sandal held by straps across or round the foot, including one that adds a toe loop or toe post to a strap across the foot (T-strap).

name: Heeled or wedge sandal
definition: sandal on a heel or wedge.

name: Sports and outdoor sandal
definition: sandal with adjustable straps on a treaded sole.

name: Gladiator sandal
definition: flat or low sandal with multiple straps up the foot or leg.

name: Woven leather sandal (huarache)
definition: sandal with a woven-leather upper.

name: Raised wooden sandal (geta)
definition: sandal on a raised wooden base with teeth.

name: Closed slipper
definition: backed slipper.

name: Open (backless) slipper
definition: slipper without a back.

name: Slipper boot
definition: soft boot without a rigid outsole.

name: Overshoe and galosh
definition: waterproof covering worn over a shoe.

name: Spat
definition: cloth or leather covering for the instep and ankle worn over a shoe.
